_history_what: George's own past Easy Apply answers, from his LinkedIn data export of 2026-10-29 (931 applications 2018-01 to 2026-09-04, Jobs/Job Applications*.csv) plus LinkedIn's saved screening prefill. Key = question text, lower-cased. 'answer' = the one he used most ('others' = the rest with counts). The walker checks an exact question match here after the per-job picks and before the regex rules (George 10/29: one book, most-used answer wins). Rebuild: python3 -I scripts/build_history.py /root/.linkedin-export scripts/answers.json.
